summary: Pressure transient at ST-01 consistent with compressor startup. Pressure fluctuated by ~14 PSI over a 19-minute window then returned to baseline. Mass balance deficit remained near zero throughout. No sustained gas loss detected.

observations.label: Pressure fluctuation at event onset
observations.value: 772.28 PSI with swings to 758.37–777.04 PSI over 20 minutes

observations.label: Compressor status
observations.value: Running at 3550 RPM throughout — consistent with active compressor operation

observations.label: Mass balance deficit
observations.value: Ranged from -0.022 to +0.020 MMSCFD — within normal noise, no sustained deficit

observations.label: Pressure recovery
observations.value: Returned to 774.57 PSI within 25 minutes — full recovery

alternatives_considered.reason: Pressure fully recovered within 25 minutes. Mass balance deficit did not persist. Pattern matches compressor startup transient signature per operating procedures.

recommended_actions.action: Continue normal monitoring — no emergency response required
recommended_actions.basis: Pipeline Operating Procedures — compressor transient response

recommended_actions.action: Verify compressor start event logged in SCADA event log for shift handover
recommended_actions.basis: Pipeline Operating Procedures — shift handover checklist
